Currency migration completeness: sweep for BARE minor-units money literals (amount:/par_value:/N cents with no $) missed by the $-anchored inventory — 3 found & fixed in 04 this run; audit 06 and any schema examples for the same pattern.

Payment-rails PO confirmations (from 20260724-payment-rails): (a) confirm the Transaction `type` enum remap WIRE_OUT->RTGS_OUT / RTP_*->EXTERNAL_ACH_PLUS_* (04:219, flagged [UNVERIFIED]); (b) decide the RTGS_IN gap — enum has RTGS_OUT but no inbound large-value type (carried from baseline WIRE_OUT/no-WIRE_IN).

CODE SYNC (high priority, natural next after vendor-removal): adopt the vendor-removal rename table in the backend — models (persona_inquiry_id->kyc_inquiry_id, plaid_item_ref->account_link_ref, PLAID_INSTANT->INSTANT_LINK enum, etc.), 0001_initial migration DDL, and OpenAPI schemas (~124 hits).
